criteria.name: Product specificity
criteria.notes: Text-to-video artifact has no reference-image input; it fails exact-product affiliate specificity by architecture.

criteria.name: Output quality
criteria.notes: No independent or AIVP perceptual evaluation.

criteria.name: Control and consistency
criteria.notes: Calibration, rank, precision, resolution, frames and seed are recorded; repeated generation is untested.

criteria.name: Workflow strength
criteria.notes: Diffusers structure is packaged, but creator-hardware setup is undocumented.

criteria.name: Speed and reliability
criteria.notes: Calibration timing is not inference performance; no render/error data.

criteria.name: Cost efficiency
criteria.notes: No model fee, but compute and accepted-output cost are unknown.

criteria.name: Commercial rights
criteria.notes: Artifact and upstream model declare Apache-2.0.

criteria.name: Automation and integration
criteria.notes: Diffusers pipeline and machine-readable run/export manifests support automation; no AIVP audit.

criteria.name: AU creator/SMB fit
criteria.notes: Ungated files, but hardware requirements for inference are not documented.

criteria.name: Monetization fit
criteria.notes: No affiliate route and no evidence of conversion utility.

analysis: A documented quantization artifact for narrative T2V workflows. It cannot meet exact-product specificity and lacks inference-quality, speed, reliability and cost evidence.
confidence_notes: Primary repository manifests and upstream documentation only; no AIVP run.

hard_gates.integration: Blocked on audited no-cost NVIDIA access.
